fact: Law No. 03/2016 on the Protection of Personal Data was adopted by the National Assembly on 15 February 2016, promulgated on 18 March 2016 and published in Diário da República No. 39 of 10 May 2016.
title: Lei n.º 03/2016 Protecção de Dados Pessoais
publisher: Assembleia Nacional / Diário da República de São Tomé e Príncipe
